message.skyabyss.ember.trial.east.door_o: The door is open. Something stirs inside

message.skyabyss.ember.trial.south.douse: Ash is thrown on the hearth

message.skyabyss.ember.mob.command.ignit: Broke the shells of %s Ash Thralls
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ember_titan.title: The One That Swims the Earth
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ember_titan.body:
The hill beyond the fields had come a little closer overnight. In the morning, only the soil between the hill and the fields was warm, in a long band.

That night the hill breathed smoke, and slept.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ember_ruins.title: The Forge of the Ash Folk
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ember_ruins.body:
Deep in the chest stood a great forge. Bellows, anvil, quenching trough: all within reach, as if someone had used them a moment ago.

Here and there, the ash on the floor was heaped as high as a person.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.forge_ledger.body:
Each day, a count of what was fed to the forge. Toward the end the numbers grow. Year by year, it seems, the fire needed more to keep it alive.

The last line is not a number. It says only: "down."
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ash_smith.title: The Ash Smith
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ash_smith.body:
The hammer fell to the floor, but the tongs never let go of the bloom. It was still red.

As if it were waiting for the last blow it was meant to receive.
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.ember_stilled.bod:
The ember heart stopped. One by one the veins went dark, and the room grew suddenly cold. Only the ash kept falling.

Where did this fire come from, and where has it gone?
lore.skyabyss.chapter1.inscription_ember: It stood on the titan's tongue, just before the throat. It reads like a welcome, or like an order.
It stood beside the great forge in the hall. Looking into the forge's floor, the red glow goes on far below.
It stood on the far shore of the Ash Path. Even as you read, the cooled crust underfoot creaked.
It was carved above the quenching trough in the Smith's Hall. One of the four is in your hands now.
It was carved into the hearthstone at the bottom of the rift. Each time the fire thins, the ground seems to sink a little.
It was on the wall of the room before the Ember Depths. This one alone has been carved over, again and again.
item.skyabyss.lore_page.desc.ember_back: Found on the ember titan's back. Columns of numbers in sooty ink
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.whisper.tong: You stand on the tongue. From deep in the throat, a breath like a bellows comes and goes
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.whisper.thro: The gauge at the top right is your heat. It rises near lava and falls in ash heaps. While you are flushed, ash shells crack easily
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.whisper.hub: Ring the three kindle stones, west, east and south, and the central forge will cool and its floor will open
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.whisper.west: Scatter ash from the urn on the lava to make a crust road. The crust soon crumbles. Ash heaps on the islands refill the urn
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.whisper.east: Read the forge's color. Strike when it matches the mark. Then quench it before it cools and cracks
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.whisper.sout: Do not let the hearth die. Feed it live coals, and lure enemies over the vents
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.whisper.well: The forge's heat escapes up the shaft. If you climb, climb in one breath
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.whisper.hear: From under the grate rise an ember glow and a beat that comes a little late
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.surface.slee: The soil smells hot. Somewhere, a mountain is breathing in its sleep...
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.surface.brea: While it breathes in, into the mouth
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.surface.spat: The titan's breath spat you out. It is too soon
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.surface.ston: Somehow, there is a warm stone in your pocket
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.surface.aske: You grip the stone. Tonight it will sleep near here
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.surface.ask_: The stone stays cool. Someone else has called it tonight
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.back.stone_r: A kindle stone rang. One of the hall's fires sank
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.back.all_sto: All three kindle stones rang. The forge cools, and the grate in its floor opens
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.back.trial_a: The fire of the %s sleeps for now
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.east.doused: Ash was thrown into the forge
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.east.quenche: The key hissed, and set hard
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.east.door: Fire runs along the door's pattern
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.south.low: The fire has grown small again
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.south.full: The hearth fire rises all the way to the rift above
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.smith.wake: Before the forge, a great ash-covered shape picks up its hammer
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.smith.fallen: The smith falls to its knees. The tongs still grip the bloom
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.heart.chill: The veins go dark. The room is growing cold
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.heart.fragme: The fourth fragment. In your hand, it searches for the others
message.skyabyss.ember.lore.finale.dawn: Far beneath your feet, something turned over in its sleep
item.skyabyss.ember_armor.desc: Two pieces harden the shell; four let heat settle into you. On the ember titan's back heat builds slowly, and your blows land harder while flushed. Touching fire fills you with strength
item.skyabyss.ember_war_axe.desc: Leaves what it strikes smoldering. Bites deeper into anything burning or smoldering
item.skyabyss.ember_mantle.desc: While worn as a trinket, heat builds slowly and fire and lava hurt less (it does not stop fire itself)
item.skyabyss.kindling_charm.desc: When used, it draws the heat out of your body and breathes it onto nearby foes (rests 50 seconds after use)
item.skyabyss.smith_hammer.desc: A two-handed sledge. Every third blow sends a crack through the floor that erupts a moment later
item.skyabyss.thrall_poker.desc: Long reach. Each blow heaps ash on the foe; when it sets, their legs and guard go dull
item.skyabyss.ember_lantern.desc: While worn as a trinket, it once holds you up against a fatal blow and burns what is near (sleeps 600 seconds after)
item.skyabyss.ember_horn.desc: A warm drink with embers melted into it. On the ember titan's back it slows your heat; elsewhere it wards off fire for a while
item.skyabyss.ember_shard.desc: A still-warm flake of the ember titan's shell. Used to temper ember gear
item.skyabyss.ember_core.desc: An ember from the ember heart that will not go out. One day it will become part of a relic
item.skyabyss.spark_dust.desc: Powder shed from an ember moth's wings. Works in fireworks in place of gunpowder
item.skyabyss.cinder_husk.desc: A plate from a cinder roller's back. Even cold, its seams glow faintly red
gui.skyabyss.forge.exchange_no_clear.emb: Defeat the ember heart to choose
gui.skyabyss.forge.exchange_all_owned.em: You already own every ember legendary
tooltip.skyabyss.ember.horn_drunk: Warmth spreads slowly from your core. Heat will build more slowly for a while
